frame_compare_help: Only add runs if the interaction, device settings and build configuration match except for the change under test. P95 is the median of run P95s; misses use classified frames only. n = measured/all. For each exact probe: overlap P95 [covered runs; matched windows / spans]. Missing is not zero. Compatible frame budgets do not prove identical refresh rates or causality.
frame_opt_consent: Enable source for this run and approve the exact method excerpt before requesting an optimization.
frame_opt_review_help: Review the change and behavior first. No source is overwritten. Check the diff against the stated version, build/test, then compare repeated FrameTimeline captures under the same conditions.
